subject: Sprint-slot syndication and quote brokerage for Horizon Data dedicated pool
messages:
From: Sarah Hall <sarah@horizondata.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: carlos.m@cloudbroker.io
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint-slot syndication & quote: Horizon Data dedicated pool

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — Horizon remains excited about moving forward with a 120-card dedicated pool tied to the Q4 contract. We're finalizing procurement windows and need to lock an OEM quote + cloud-broker fallback by Nov 10 so our procurement committee can approve shipment windows.

As discussed, the constraints that matter to us:
- Staging window no earlier than mid-Jan (we need customs clearance buffer)
- A hard requirement that 40% of the capacity be able to be backfilled via cloud-broker within 48 hours for the first 12 weeks
- Vendor quote should include lead time SLAs and a clear list of skus that can be swapped for equivalent perf/price if an eta slips

I've attached our high-level capacity matrix. Can Redwood confirm: 1) whether the Q4 slot you referenced can be reserved pending OEM quote; 2) mechanism & cost for the 48-hour cloud backfill (broker fees, ephemeral instances, expected delta in latency); and 3) if there are any blackout dates around holidays we should be aware of for shipment.

Attachments: Capacity-Staging-Matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Hall
Head of Infrastructure Programs | Horizon Data

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hall <sarah@horizondata.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, carlos.m@cloudbroker.io
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint-slot syndication & quote: Horizon Data dedicated pool

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the matrix. Quick answers up front:
1) We can hold the Q4 reservation pending a signed LOI through Nov 10; we just need a written confirmation and a nominal deposit (we'll outline amounts after OEM quote).
2) Cloud backfill (48h) will be brokered through our preferred partners; estimated incremental cost ~20-30% above committed on-prem card unit economics for the first 12 weeks (depends on sustained throughput). I'll have Carlos (cc'd) provide a firm broker estimate for the skus you listed.
3) Blackout dates: our OEM partners typically have reduced shipping the last two weeks of Dec and Jan 1 week; I'll confirm specific carrier constraints once I have the quote.

Next steps I propose:
- We request an updated OEM quote that includes a swap/clawback clause and explicit lead-time SLAs (Enterprisex has a template we prefer).
- Carlos to provide the 48h broker pricing and an example invoice cadence.
- Redwood to produce a provisional staging schedule (ETA windows) that we can share with your procurement committee.

I've looped Karthik to drive the OEM quote alignment and Laura to match the staging schedule to our onboarding calendar.

I'll follow up with an internal note once we have the OEM doc.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: OEM-Quote-Enterprisex-v2.pdf (requested in follow-up)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Sarah Hall <sarah@horizondata.com>
Cc: oem-sales@enterprisex.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint-slot syndication & quote: Horizon Data dedicated pool

Sarah / Team — I'm engaging Enterprisex ops to get a formal quote with SLA language. Initial signals:
- Current queue for the Q4 slot is gated on component availability; Enterprisex can commit to a tentative manufacture slot but will only firm ETA after PO + deposit.
- They can add a "swap" appendix: allow substitution between A100-80GB and next-gen 96GB-equivalent SKU with a 5% price/throughput reconciliation clause.
- Lead time breakouts: ordering -> allocation ~6-8 weeks; allocation -> ship ~4-6 weeks depending on freight. So nominal 10-14 weeks; exceptions possible if components come in earlier.

I'll push for tighter windows and add a clause for partial shipments so Horizon can start onboarding in waves. I'll attach the vendor's draft quote as soon as they send it.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Procurement (Redwood)

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sarah Hall <sarah@horizondata.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint-slot syndication & quote: Horizon Data dedicated pool

Quick ops note from capacity planning:
- We ran a stress projection for the 120-card pool and the recommended staging rollout is 30/30/30/30 across four waves to minimize cache-warmup regressions and reduce initial latency surprises; this also maps well to partial shipments Karthik called out.
- Cloud backfill: Carlos' broker estimate (attached separately) shows that ephemeral instances can hit the 48-hour backfill requirement but expect a 12-18% degradation in p95 compared to pinned dedicated cards — call this a measured SLA for the committee.

Action items before Nov 10:
1) Karthik — push Enterprisex for partial-shipment language + a confirmed lead-time table; get the PDF quote to Priyom.
2) Priyom/Laura — draft the LOI + nominal deposit terms we can share with Horizon procurement.
3) Sarah — confirm whether Horizon requires a DocuSign envelope for the LOI or if a signed PDF is fine.

Attachment: none in this thread (broker file was shared off-thread by Carlos).

Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hall <sarah@horizondata.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint-slot syndication & quote: Horizon Data dedicated pool

Sarah — quick status update and deliverables for your procurement review:

1) Enterprisex sent the attached OEM quote with a partial-shipment appendix and swap clause. See OEM-Quote-Enterprisex-v2.pdf. They show a conditional lead time of 11 weeks (ordering to ship) with a 10% chance of a 2–3 week slip due to component risk.
2) Carlos (cloud broker) provided a firm 48h backfill pricing schedule and invoice cadence — I forwarded their sheet to Procurement earlier this morning.
3) Redwood LOI + deposit draft is attached as DocuSign-Terms-HZ-2026-09.pdf. It contains the nominal deposit amount, reservation hold, and an outline for partial shipment acceptance testing windows.

If Horizon is comfortable with the conditional lead-time and the partial shipment plan (Ben's 30/30/30/30 wave), we can proceed with LOI and hold the Q4 slot. Please confirm by EOD Monday (Nov 9) so we can lock the OEM queue.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if procurement needs to walk the language.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OEM-Quote-Enterprisex-v2.pdf; DocuSign-Terms-HZ-2026-09.pdf
